pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0142 agent benchmark catalog
pr_body:
## Summary

- Add a versioned GameEngine Agent Benchmark with machine-local evidence records, explicit unavailable telemetry, and fail-closed same-harness comparison rules.
- Add loopback installed-model discovery and an evidence-derived curated catalog that never invents or silently downloads recommendations.
- Surface Compatible / unverified versus benchmark-qualified model status and explicit benchmark recording in AI Studio.
- Preserve ADR0152 multi-agent writer semantics by including immutable work-claim budgets in write-capable benchmark comparison identity.
- Accept ADR0142 and document the first-release implementation boundary.

## Validation

- GameEngine Windows Validation
- Editor Visual Validation
